company.name: NordFlow A/S
company.description: Danish B2B industrial company selling pumps, spare parts/components and service & maintenance contracts in Denmark, Sweden and Germany.

story.headline: Revenue is up ~3.5% (DKK 86m -> 89m) but operating profit is down ~33% (DKK 12m -> 8m); margin falls from ~14% to ~9%.

drivers.summary: German sales headcount grew 8 -> 12. New pipeline +35%, but win rate fell 31% -> 19% (new reps win ~12%, veterans ~23%). Germany costs rose (people + cars, travel, office, trade fair) while German revenue fell ~8% and discounting cut equipment margins.

Rheinmark Chemie and Brandauer Papierwerke were reassigned from a veteran account manager to two newly hired reps in Sep/Oct 2025. Account activity dropped, Rheinmark's service contract renewal and follow-on deals were lost, Brandauer moved spare parts to a local distributor. Their combined H1 revenue fell ~DKK 3.6m, more than Germany's entire net decline.

Danish revenue grew ~9-10%, but high-margin service fell ~23% (a third of service-contract value was not renewed at end-2025) while lower-margin equipment grew ~30% at bigger discounts. Danish gross profit is DOWN despite revenue growth.
A company-wide raise of ~3.5-4% in Jan 2026 is visible on every payslip but explains only ~DKK 0.55m (about a third of the personnel increase and ~15% of the profit decline).

story.sweden: Stable control market: revenue roughly flat, win rate ~30%, slight margin improvement.

scenario_invariants.description: Story-critical outcomes enforced by construction (src/config.py, 'Scenario invariants') so they hold for every seed; checks marked "invariant": true verify them. src/robustness.py runs all checks across many seeds.
scenario_invariants.dk_contract_billing: Danish service-contract billing H1 2026 is 25% below H1 2025 (band -20% to -30%): end-2025 renewal losses are sized after new contracts and mid-year renewals.
scenario_invariants.de_new_rep_win_rate: German expansion hires win 12% of deals closed in H1 2026 (band 8-16%); veterans take the remainder (band 20-30%) so the overall German rate stays ~19%.
scenario_invariants.de_key_accounts_lead: Rheinmark and Brandauer are the two largest German decliners, each at least DKK 0.3m ahead of the next customer: no other German customer may win more than DKK 0.8m of equipment in any 12-month window.
scenario_invariants.de_won_value: German won value (non-renewal deals closed in the half) falls 25% H1 2026 vs H1 2025 (band -15% to -35%) despite +35% pipeline: winners are swapped within each rep stratum, keeping win counts unchanged.

metric_definitions.revenue: Sum of invoice_lines.net_amount * invoices.exchange_rate (DKK), including credit notes, by invoice_date.
metric_definitions.personnel_costs: Payroll employer_cost_dkk by pay_period (equals ERP ledger accounts 2210-2230).
metric_definitions.other_opex: ERP ledger_entries on accounts of type 'opex' (2710-3510), by date.
metric_definitions.operating_profit: revenue - cogs - personnel_costs - other_opex. Margin = operating_profit / revenue.
metric_definitions.market: ERP: customers.country; CRM: deals.market (fallback companies.country, then deals.deal_currency); Payroll: employees.country. Mapped via mappings/value_mappings.csv.
metric_definitions.product_category: ERP: products.product_group_number; CRM: deals.product_category. Mapped via mappings/value_mappings.csv.
metric_definitions.pipeline_created: Sum of deals.amount_company_currency (DKK) for non-renewal deals with created_at in the period.
metric_definitions.win_rate: won / (won + lost) by count, non-renewal deals with closed_at in the period.
metric_definitions.de_sales_headcount: Payroll employees with country=DE and department=Sales employed on the date.
metric_definitions.salary_inflation_effect: Base-salary change (June 2026 vs June 2025) for employees paid in both months, applied to their H1 2025 employer cost.
metric_definitions.existing_vs_new_customers: Existing = invoiced in H1 2025. New = first-ever invoice after 2025-06-30.
metric_definitions.counterfactual: Extra German wins = (win rate 2025H1 - win rate 2026H1) * deals closed in 2026H1, valued at the average 2026H1 lost-deal amount and the 2026H1 German equipment gross margin. Upper bound (assumes invoicing within the period, ignores commission).
